seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Ring+beam move A1/A2 by 6 rows carrying on-beam blocks and pushing hit blocks; whole move cancels if any block leaves the colour-4 field or the ring leaves its rows.
A4/A3 change beam width by 6: a hooked next/collected block (x == tip-4) drags every on-beam block; otherwise extending pushes swept next/collected blocks. If the group is blocked, the beam slides alone.
Tags: a hooked next with all other on-beam blocks collected becomes collected; with no hook, a collected block off the beam reverts to next. Legend swatch centre 2x2 = 0 while collected.
Background: 4 in the field, rail columns 2/3 with period 6 from top+2 to bot-2, else 5. Clicks are full no-ops.
Open: the HUD bar adds one 3 every 3 non-click actions, but its phase is hidden. It is tracked only while frames are continuous; the stateless fallback 3*bars+1 passes 32/45.
